cards.front: Before ovulation, estrogen from the growing follicles thickens the endometrium in the [___] phase.
cards.context:
The endometrial cycle mirrors the ovarian one. Estrogen from the follicles drives proliferation before ovulation.

After ovulation, progesterone from the corpus luteum converts the thickened lining to the secretory phase.

cards.front: The main indication for menopausal hormone therapy is troublesome [___] symptoms.
cards.context: Hot flushes and night sweats are the commonest reason to start MHT, and it is the most effective treatment for them.

cards.front: Tamoxifen is used to treat estrogen receptor-positive [___] cancer.
cards.context: Tamoxifen blocks estrogen receptors in breast tissue and is used for estrogen receptor-positive disease. Hot flushes are a common side effect.
